description: Best-effort derivation of the real headless dump into a unit with a CNU2 display (switched on) and its built-in room T/H sensors: PH01 = 1 and HA00 = 6 (the handbook pair for 'with CNU2'), no external probes (HA02 = HA03 = 0), and room readings in place of the unwired sentinel. Not a real dump; replace with one in tests/devices/ when available.
